A only notes that May was the peak month. One flaw in B: it gives the yearly average as $44 per order, but $274,400 ÷ 6,370 orders is about $43. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers use aligned bar panels with zero baselines on a shared month axis, which avoids the dual-axis problem. B's only cross-series note is that May was the peak for both, and it labels the value on the May bar alone.
